RQST/CURRENT HASH MATCH code indicates key update is not required.
Segment Type field has fixed value 100 for Standard Message Data Segment.
Value 'Y' in Alternate MICR IND indicates Alternate MICR format is being sent from the terminal.
Fuel Volume Data field length is determined by segment length in field 2, up to max 3,600.
Segment Type fixed value is 119.
Account Updater Expiration Date is applicable only to Visa and MasterCard.
Connector type field has maximum length of 3 characters.
For fuel and nonfuel amounts together with discounts/coupons, discounts/coupons are first applied to the nonfuel amount.
Nonfuel Amount valid values are 1-99999999.
Number of Card Types valid values are 01-99.
Number of Print Lines does not include Data Element 168, Count of Receipt Text Line.
Data Element 168 count does not reflect total from Number of Print Lines.
Number of Print Lines information comes from BUYPASS.
Number of Print Lines valid values are 1, 2, or 3.
Number of Products must precede single digits (1-9) with a zero (01-09).
Number of Products valid values range from 01 to 10.
